closed.description: Every period of the year is closed: its last month's close closes the year, as periods close in order.

expenses.description: The year's expenses so far: debits, so positive.

income.description: The year's revenue so far in the base currency, as in the trial balance: credits, so negative.

last_period.description: The year's last period, whose close is the year-end close.

number.description: The financial year, 1 for the first.

periods.description: How many of its periods there are: a year opens whole, so all of its months.

periods_closed.description: How many of them are closed.

result.description: income + expenses: negative is a profit, which credits retained earnings; positive is a loss.

retained_earnings.description: Absent while no account has the retained-earnings role: then nothing folds, and revenue and expense accounts carry on from year to year.

starts_on.description: Its first day: the books start for the first year.
